lines.meet: Renata Rojas, stuntwoman, Mexico City. I fall off things professionally, so relax when you see me near an edge.
lines.meet_neighbour: Hey, Halcyon Rest's home for you too! Look for the woman walking along the rim of the falls like it's a pavement.
lines.ask_home: So where'd you grow up? You seem like somebody from a big loud city.
lines.ask_work: What paid your rent back home? Tell me it was something dangerous.
lines.answer_home: Mexico City, Roma Norte, a rooftop flat with a crash mat in the living room. Twenty million people and every one of them honking.
lines.answer_work: Stunts, nine years. Doubling actresses off buildings, out of cars and down stairs so they didn't have to.
lines.chat_food: Tacos al pastor from a street cart at midnight, pineapple on top, eaten standing up. Best meal in the world.
lines.chat_sleep: I sleep on anything, anywhere, the second I'm horizontal. Film sets teach you that fast.
lines.chat_missing: The quiet second before action, when the whole crew holds its breath and it's just you and the drop.
lines.chat_here: I woke up right on the edge of an island and nearly went over before I opened my eyes. It felt like a normal day at work.
lines.tease_quiet: Stunt double material, {name}. Nobody'd ever notice you weren't the star.
lines.tease_talker: You'd make a great director, {name}. You never stop telling everybody what's happening.
lines.tease_careful: You treat your gear like a rigger, {name}. Respect, honestly, it keeps people alive.
lines.tease_bold: You'd jump off anything, {name}, and I mean that as a compliment, mostly.
lines.tease_any: I'd cast you as the guy who falls off the horse, {name}. You've got the face for it.
lines.tease_back: Ha, nice one, {name}, that's a clean hit.
lines.take_it_kindly: Okay, fair, {name}. My mother would be on your side.
lines.bristle: Hey, quit it, {name}. A friend went through a windscreen on my set, and that's not funny.
lines.needle_quiet: Shout when you see something coming, okay? Silence on a set gets people hurt.
lines.needle_talker: Quiet on set, please! I can't hear my cue over you.
lines.needle_careful: At some point you've got to stop checking and just do the take.
lines.needle_bold: Even I think you're reckless, and I fall off buildings for a living. Check your gear.
lines.needle_any: You never check your straps, and I'm sick of doing it for you.
lines.bite_back: I've taken out half of everything we've fought before you even saw it. Don't tell me I'm slacking.
lines.hurt: Ouch, that one stung, I'll admit it. I'm gonna go walk the rim for a bit.
lines.laugh_off: A director once told me I fell like a sack of potatoes, on camera, in front of the whole crew. You'll need better material.
lines.apologise: Okay, my bad, that was out of line. I get mouthy when I'm tired.
lines.double_down: Nope, I'm not taking it back. Somebody needed telling.
lines.confide: {name}, a rigger skipped his checks on my set, and my friend went through a windscreen. He can't work anymore.
lines.listen: Talk to me, {name}. I'm better at listening than I look.
lines.look_out: I'll go first, {name}, you stay behind me.
lines.accept: You're the director, {name}, so it's your call.
lines.deflect: Just a bruise, {name}, a bad landing does worse. Check on everybody else.
lines.check_in: You landed hard there, {name}. Sit down, show me where it hurts.
lines.blame: Somebody skipped their check, and the whole stunt went wrong.
lines.thank: You caught me there, and I don't usually need catching. Thank you, really.
lines.brush_off: Forget it, catching people is half the job.
lines.worry: Hey, {name}, eyes on me, stay with me. You're okay, I've got you.
lines.handed_down: This one's yours, take it back.
lines.hand_fine: Sure, take it. I did nine years of stunts in borrowed costumes.
lines.hand_sulk: Didn't ask the stuntwoman, huh. Whatever, I'm fine.
lines.turn_friendly: I'd trust you to check my rig, {name}, and I don't trust anyone with my rig.
lines.turn_friends: You're my safety, {name}. I'd jump off anything if you were the one watching.
lines.turn_grating: We're not a great double act, are we. Fine, we'll still hit our marks.
lines.turn_rivals: If you fall, I'll still catch you. Just don't expect me to be nice about it.
lines.make_up: Okay, {name}, cut, reset. Can we do take two?
lines.defend: Hey, lay off, that's not right. {name} nailed their part.
lines.friend_left: Halcyon Rest's boring with {name} gone. Nobody watches when I jump off things.
lines.friend_back: Finally, {name}'s back! Now I've got an audience again.
lines.common_mexico: You're Mexican, right? Chilango, or from somewhere quieter? Tell me everything.
lines.common_spanish: Somebody who speaks Spanish, thank God. Talk to me, I've missed swearing properly.
lines.common_sport: You're an athlete, aren't you? You land like somebody who knows how to fall.
